items.title: Mobile App Engineer (Tech Lead) - Asahi Shimbun
items.summary: A tech lead position for mobile app development at Asahi Shimbun Company's Digital Business Headquarters. Responsible for iOS/Android development supporting the Asahi Shimbun digital edition which receives 140 million monthly page views. The team uses Scrum methodology with 1-week sprints.

items.title: Full-Stack Mobile Engineer - Blued
items.summary: A mobile engineer role for the product team behind StudyIn, Japan’s No. 1 overseas education travel service. The role involves developing mobile apps and backend APIs, and planning/implementing AI agents.
